highlights.title: Plan-file safety prompts are approved for you
highlights.line: A Claude Code safety check on a command that only touches an agent's plan files is now approved for you.

highlights.title: A tall safety prompt does not buzz your phone
highlights.line: A safety check left to you shows as a card line, not a phone buzz, even when its box is taller than the window.

highlights.title: Mac agent restarts say why
highlights.line: When a Claude agent's process stops on its own on the Mac and Kosmos starts it again, its card now says when and why.

highlights.title: A file that did not arrive whole is refused
highlights.line: A file sent from the board that arrives incomplete is refused, saying how much arrived; an Office or zip file missing its end is marked.

highlights.title: Account moves ask for a handoff first
highlights.line: Moving an agent to another account now asks it to write a handoff first, and its new session is pointed at it.
